Minhali account and contact UPDATEs run for every matched row with no change detection, and overwrite with NULL when the file value is NULL (name, dates, gendercode, gen_bankcustomeridnumber, buildingid, city, gen_postalcode…).

UPDate contact binds the STRING date columns (Gen_Customerdateofbirth, Gen_DeathDate, Gen_identityNumberIssuingDate, 'yyyy/MM/dd') to dbTimeStamp parameters Param_7..9 (DTSX 34375-34377). The DateTime columns produced by 'Derived Column' + 'Convert To Date Time' (gen_*_DateTime) are not consumed by any CRM write (dead computation). In the Minhali account UPDATE the parsed gen_customerdateofbirth_DateTime IS used (Param_4).

Employers 'Update Account': updates of accountnumber, fax, telephone1, telephone2 are commented out (main.cs:141-145,179-196) and emailaddress1 is never updated; CheckIfToUpdate treats file NULL vs CRM value as a change and writes NULL (clears CRM). address1_postalcode_db = isnull(Address1_PostalCode,'0000000') so a NULL file zip on an account with NULL zip is re-updated on every run.

Employers lookup 'Check if account exists' filters statecode = 0 (inactive account with the same accountnumber → a new account is created), while the Minhali accounts lookup has no statecode filter (inactive account blocks creation and gets the SQL UPDATE).

Employers 'Create Additional Columns' writes building + "/" + apartment back into gen_address1_buildingid wstr(10) with truncation = FailComponent (DTSX 5755): a combined value longer than 10 chars fails the data flow. Contacts use LEFT(...,10); Minhali accounts use a new wstr(16) column.
Employers Create Account main.cs:153-156: the if (!Row.genreturnedmailcount_IsNull) has no braces, so address1_name = "ראשי" (line 156, indented) is unconditional (raw DTSX 4711-4714).
Mailbox_78 (→ gen_postalcode) is not an input of 'Trim String Fields' in the Minhali accounts and contacts data flows, so it is written exactly as stored in MY_FileData.

Tool caveats for compose: (1) origins.mjs marks the lookup KEY columns accountnumber (Employers, Minhali) and gen_identitynumber (contacts) as 'replaced-by-lookup', but their CopyFromReferenceColumn is System.Null (DTSX 4231, 15126, 23799) — they are not overwritten; role in the writes is 'value'. (2) origins.mjs does not follow columns referenced inside replace-in-place expressions or readWrite script swaps; the extra file fields are listed per attribute in additionalFileFields (Employer_Name_39 → account.name, Employer_Number_38 → account.accountnumber, Address_Apartment_Number_101 → gen_address1_buildingid, Phone_2_Number_106 → contact.telephone1, Phone_1_Number_14 → contact.telephone2).
contact.fullname is set explicitly (SDK create and SQL update) from 'lastname firstname'; CRM normally composes fullname itself.

ContactLog CASE for gen_customerpreferencetransmissionstatus has no ELSE (DTSX 26738-26742) → NULL text when the status value is not 1/2 (possible because of the isUpdateCustomerPreference bug, which can log unchanged CRM values).

ErrorText outputs (CastingError/Error) of the write scripts only feed ETL Warning (plumbing) and are not mapped. Lookups in these flows read CRM tables (account, contact, product, gen_bankbranch, gen_estatecodeid), not staging tables — no lookupBridges. 'Get fund type name(product)', 'Get bank branch Id', 'Get Employer Number Estate' outputs are not used by any CRM write in Employers.
